name: Free Territory of Trieste (1947–1954)
description: A red field charged with a white halberd.
history: Flag of the Free Territory of Trieste, the UN-protected city-state created by the 1947 Italian peace treaty and divided between Italy and Yugoslavia in 1954.

features.symbolism: Trieste's medieval emblem, said to have fallen from the sky at the martyrdom of St Sergius
